description: Land Acquisition - Daramitipola, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, containing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and ownership claims. It involves a declaration that lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired, which falls under land and property-related matters. While it mentions a Minister's name, this is incidental to the land acquisition notice itself and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
